title: ContributionEvent
description: Canonical contract between Layer 1 (work) and Layer 2 (avatar). Avatar Architecture Canon §7. v2 uses proof_ref; the legacy v1 key `attestation` is accepted on read.

kind.description: `contribution` is a legacy v1 alias for `fact`.

proof_ref.description: Required iff trust_level is attested or verified.

attestation.description: DEPRECATED v1 mirror of proof_ref. Dual-written during the shim; removed after migration.

payload.description: Domain payload for kind=fact. No source code, no secrets, no economic keys.

declares_for.description: event_id of the fact a claim refers to.

$comment: Invariant (not expressible in plain JSON Schema): the event MUST NOT contain economic-layer keys (pi, gpi, creator_bonus, clearing, marketplace, scarcity_index, portability_index, amount, currency, bonus). Enforced by avatar_contract.assert_economic_barrier.
